page_notes.478: Flush Plastic Panel Handle (5-112): 2056, 2058 and metric-dimensioned 65-2056, 65-2058, all badged F and M; requires Flush Handle Plastic Panel Milling (11-39).
page_notes.479: Locking Plastic Panel Grabber Handle (5-113): 2730 and 65-2730 under merged 10/15/25/30/40/45 badge cell; included hardware 3062 and 3382 attached; 3058 (10-series) and metric suggested hardware 11-6514, 14126 skipped.
page_notes.480: Deluxe Door Handle with Pawl Kit (5-114): 2055 and 2063 (15); metric 40-2055, 40-2063 skipped.
page_notes.481: Deluxe Door Mating Handle (5-115): 2052 (15); metric 40-2052 skipped.
page_notes.482: Furniture Style Handle (5-116, T-shape pictured): eight 10/15 rows 2082, 2083, 2952, 2953, 2932, 2933, 2922, 2923; 25/40 metric 65- rows skipped.
page_notes.483: Furniture Style Handle continued (5-117, L-shape pictured): eight 10/15 rows 2087, 2089, 2957, 2959, 2937, 2939, 2927, 2929; 25/40 metric 65- rows skipped.
page_notes.484: Furniture Style Handle Pawl Kit (5-118): 2763 (10 to 15), 2765 and 2760 (15); 2761 (10 only) and metric 25-2761, 65-2763, 40-2765, 40-2760 skipped.
page_notes.485: Slam Latch (5-119): 12145, 12146, 12147 under merged 15/30/40/45 badge cell; suggested hardware 13-6516 and 13119 attached (13117, 13129 metric-only skipped).

remaining_doubts: 2055: printed weight .301 lb looks inconsistent with 2063 (.695 lb) and metric 40-2055 (.3012 kg, about .66 lb); kept verbatim as printed.
2929: printed weight .546 lb is much lower than the other clockwise L-handles (~.70 lb) and 65-2929 (.3044 kg); kept verbatim as printed.
65-2056, 65-2058, 65-2730 are metric-dimensioned rows kept because their row badges include F (2056/2058) or the merged 15 badge cell (2730).
